QuestInfo.name: Strange World: Sleepywood
QuestInfo.0: Something about Six Path Crossway felt... evil... What was the name of that place again? Sleepywood?
QuestInfo.1: Someone needs to investigate Sleepywood, and it looks like you're the best person for the job.
QuestInfo.2: You bumped into Kaiser from Pantheon while you were in Sleepywood, and he mentioned that he might have good news. Hopefully he'll contact you soon.

0.msg: You can sense dark energy emanating from Sleepywood. There might be traces of the High Flora.
